lines.text: I'm not some homicidal maniac who kills indiscriminately.
Don't cross the law. I'd prefer not to kill you.
You want to know what's in my bag? Take a guess.
Heavy is the head that wears the crown.
You're a good person. Try and keep it that way.
Committing crime is unforgivable. Maybe it sounds cliché, but that's what I believe.
Patience is one of my strong suits.
Staying in can be enjoyable. Occasionally.
I'm at the hotel. Call me if you need anything.
Assassins always stay at hotels. Not exactly sure why.
This place is occupied entirely by Nikkes, save you, so I doubt I'll be finding any of my targets here.

Do you wish to wear the crown?
Can you really bear its weight?
Now I can get more work done.
Is this payment for an assignment? I don't accept personal commissions.
I'll put this to good use.
As long as you don't have any ulterior motives... thanks.
I knew you were a good person.
If everyone was like you, I wouldn't have to work so much.

You truly are unique,
in nearly every way possible.
Mission failed. We'll get 'em next time.
